core_obligations: Continuity and reduction to left exactness (proof lines 4089-4098): the functors are continuous by the construction of the companion lemma, and since the pullback is a left adjoint it is right exact, so it suffices to prove left exactness.

Construction of the presheaf realizing the formula (proof lines 4101-4130): for an object presented as the image of an object at some stage the author defines the value by a colimit over the further stages, notes that it is independent of the presentation (recording that the verification is omitted), checks functoriality and verifies the sheaf condition by reducing a covering to a finite level and using that filtered colimits commute with finite limits; by construction the value is the right hand side of the displayed formula.

Identification with the pullback (proof lines 4135-4168): the author verifies the universal property by comparing maps out of the constructed sheaf with maps out of the given sheaf into a pushforward, shows that the compatibility conditions force every component to be the adjoint of the identity component, and reads the argument backwards to construct the system from a single map, which the author encourages the reader to skip.

Left exactness (proof lines 4171-4179): assuming the displayed formula, the functor commutes with finite limits because finite limits of sheaves are computed as presheaves and the pullbacks along the transition morphisms commute with finite limits, while filtered colimits commute with finite limits.
proof_roadmap: Check continuity of the functors and reduce exactness of the pullback to left exactness.
Build a sheaf whose values are the displayed colimits and identify it with the pullback by a universal property.
Deduce left exactness from the formula using that filtered colimits commute with finite limits.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pullback of a sheaf along the morphism of sites from a colimit of sites: for an object at a finite level the value of the pullback is the filtered colimit, over the stages mapping to that level, of the pullbacks of the sheaf along the transition morphisms (statement lines 4075-4087). The proof is a complete argument: continuity is taken from the companion construction and exactness is reduced to left exactness because the pullback is a left adjoint (proof lines 4089-4098); the author builds a presheaf with the displayed values, checks functoriality and the sheaf condition by reducing coverings to a finite level and commuting filtered colimits with finite limits (proof lines 4101-4130); identifies it with the pullback through the universal property of the adjunction (proof lines 4135-4168); and deduces left exactness from the formula (proof lines 4171-4179). The non-formal content is the construction of the sheaf and its universal property. The claim is H2: a construction with the verification carried out in stages.
